record.edic_text:
3456 mukterizo {mook-tay-rid'-zo}

from a derivative of the base of 3455 (meaning snout, as that
   whence lowing proceeds); TDNT - 4:796,614; v

AV - mock 1; 1

1) to turn up the nose or sneer at
2) to mock, deride
